fixes.text: Previous P2 f1 did not land: the middle column still ends at the format bar (y 880) with a void down to the strip's foot (1100). Pin the rating numeral, format bar and caption as one block to the strip's bottom edge, so the three columns end on one line.

Rendered shelf draws no scent colour: add a code-tier move that draws a thin chord strip per fragrance in the list, and set the house and name as two lines, replacing the 'House: Name (accords)' text.
Rendered detail shows the accords as a comma line and the notes as 'Top: ...' lines: draw the accords as the weighted coloured bar and each tier as a row of colour swatches through the same move.

The notes are 12 equal squares, which reads as a palette grid and not a pyramid in time: make the tier swatch heights or widths step (top narrowest, base widest, or each swatch width set by note count) so the three tiers differ in shape.
Previous P3 f6 did not land and the rating is about 90px against the 150px in direction.md section 6: set the 9 to 150px so it is a real second read beside the name.
Previous P3 f3 did not land: dim 'Interested 0' or hide zero-count tabs.
Previous P3 f5 did not land: remove the bordered menu box and divider on the open split button.
